title: Change Fee Fare Bands — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand
content:
**Pricing schedule — voluntary change fees on Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** The change fee of a voluntary, standard exchange is multiplied by the **fare band rate**, which follows the fare that bands the change fee. The rate acts on the unrounded fee; the fee is rounded to the cent only at the end.

| Fare that bands the change fee (USD) | Fare band rate |
|---|---|
| 600 or more (high fare floor) | 0.92 |
| At least 400 (middle fare floor) and below 600 | 0.96 |
| Below 400 | 1 |

The fare that bands the change fee is measured from the fare collected on the ticket, which is every fare-collection and add-collect entry on its fare history.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Fare that bands the fee | Rate |
|---|---|
| 600.00 | 0.92 |
| 599.99 | 0.96 |
| 400.00 | 0.96 |
| 399.99 | 1 |

*Worked figure (hypothetical).* A fee of 260 dollars in the 0.96 band becomes 249.60 dollars.
